about: Business check — one frozen assessment per symbol: is the company doing what it promised? Read by ui/business.js for display ONLY, on both books (Apex card + Agentic plan). No stop, trim, weight, leverage, ticket or executor logic reads this file. Written weekly by the 'Business check writer' scheduled task (and by hand in Jack's chat). To change a verdict, add a NEW assessment and move the current one into history[] unchanged — never edit a past one, so forward paper tests can grade what was known at the time. Funds (SPY, VTI…) get no record.

IREN.thesis: AI cloud capacity gets built, accepted by customers and turned into recognized revenue, funded without heavy dilution.
IREN.summary: Demand up, delivery late, financing still open.
IREN.assessor: Claude (Jack's chat), from LAB-009 + the Nov 5 issuer release

milestones.name: Revenue conversion
milestones.metric: AI Cloud revenue $200M in Q1 FY27, up 182% from $71M

milestones.name: Delivery
milestones.metric: >$4B ARR target moved from year-end 2026 to Jan 31 2027, may extend to end of Feb

milestones.name: Financing & dilution
milestones.metric: $4B ARR program stated fully funded; $6B of FY27 capex still to be financed; net debt $4.4B

IREN.changed: Nov 5 print: revenue beat and backlog up 22% to $20.3B, but the >$4B ARR date slipped 1–2 months (customer-requested design change + supplier timing). ARR is a run-rate target, not recognized revenue.
invalidators: >$4B ARR not operating by Feb 28 2027, or customer acceptance fails
AI Cloud revenue falls quarter over quarter at the Q2 FY27 print
The $6B FY27 capex is funded mainly by new shares rather than contracted prepayments or GPU debt
A major customer contract is cut or cancelled

nextReview.trigger: ARR target date — delivery / customer acceptance update; then the Q2 FY27 print

AMZN.thesis: AWS expansion and more profitable retail should convert durable revenue growth into cash after infrastructure investment.
AMZN.summary: AWS accelerates; investment overwhelms free cash flow.

refClose.source: Alpha Vantage TIME_SERIES_DAILY, AMZN, raw daily close; https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/#daily

milestones.name: AWS growth
milestones.metric: Q3 2026 AWS sales $46.0B; reported growth 39% year over year.

milestones.name: Operating profitability
milestones.metric: Q3 2026 operating income $28.1B versus $17.4B in Q3 2025.

milestones.name: Positive trailing free cash flow
milestones.metric: TTM ended September 30, 2026 free cash flow -$42.4B versus +$14.8B a year earlier.

AMZN.changed: Initial assessment: AWS and operating earnings expanded, but the cash-generation milestone failed as infrastructure spending absorbed operating cash. Weakening reflects that cash shortfall, not the share price.
invalidators: AWS revenue contracts year over year while AWS operating income turns negative.
Trailing operating cash flow turns negative while infrastructure spending continues.
